## Zameen listing collector

**1.** Paste listing urls into the **Property URLs** node.

**2.** Put your sheet id into **Save to Google Sheets** and attach a Google Sheets credential.

**3.** The sheet needs a tab called `Listings` with the header row from README.md.

Run it manually first. The schedule only fires once the workflow is activated.

### Why aria-label, not class names

Zameen ships hashed css classes such as `_63ea997b`, which change whenever they deploy. The `aria-label` attributes say what an element is for, so they survive a redesign.

Checked against ten live listings in Lahore, Karachi and Islamabad: all ten returned every field.

### Duplicates

**Append or update**, matching on `listing_id`, so re-running the same url refreshes that row instead of adding a second one. The id is parsed out of the url.
